purpose: Test whether the post-benchmark/post-IT-system official BNR financial-accounts dissemination exposes a reproducible public machine-readable boundary sufficient for either the aggregate sectoral_financial_positions reference mode or, more stringently, instrument-specific bilateral Accounting Spine reopen consideration.

frozen_target.flow_measure: financial transactions; stock differences are prohibited substitutes

required_source_sector_semantics.F: S12 excluding S121, requiring exact same-boundary S12 and S121 or direct equivalent
required_source_sector_semantics.X: S2/rest-of-world orientation compatible with RMD mapping

aggregate_reference_mode_gate.purpose: Potentially observe sector-level F2-F8 stocks and transactions for all six RMD sectors without claiming bilateral Accounting Spine completion.

bilateral_accounting_reopen_gate.purpose: Determine whether a public source exposes holder/counterparty values sufficient to reconsider frozen F2/F4/F5/F6/F7/F8 accounting boundaries.
bilateral_accounting_reopen_gate.effect_if_pass: OPEN_INSTRUMENT_SPECIFIC_REPASS_ONLY; no automatic materialisation or completion.

allowed_discovery_surfaces.role: priority public-access path because BNR documentation identifies an online interactive database for monthly/quarterly series
allowed_discovery_surfaces.rule: Use published navigation/catalogue/export paths only. Do not guess internal filenames, timestamps or undocumented endpoints.

allowed_discovery_surfaces.role: verify whether the post-2025 BNR transmission topology exposes new public sector/instrument/counterpart dimensions beyond the frozen prior QSA result
allowed_discovery_surfaces.rule: A new quarterly vintage alone is not evidence; only demonstrable topology/coverage expansion counts.

allowed_discovery_surfaces.role: verify whether regular post-April-2025 Romanian transmissions expose S121 separately in any public financial-accounts dataflow satisfying the frozen boundary
allowed_discovery_surfaces.rule: Do not reinterpret the frozen counterpart dataflow that lacked S121 unless a distinct or changed public dataflow is identified.

allowed_discovery_surfaces.role: cross-check whether post-benchmark public dissemination adds exact counterpart/instrument coverage
allowed_discovery_surfaces.rule: Annual Tables 6/7 or incomplete counterpart subsets cannot substitute for the quarterly frozen target.

execution_sequence: Freeze provider, dataset/dataflow identifier, dimensions and semantic mapping before downloading values.
Retain exact raw metadata/catalogue response first; hash it.
Decide topology/semantic pass or fail before any historical value extraction.
If and only if topology passes, preregister exact historical extraction keys and requested periods.
Retain raw value response with hashes.
Run aggregate reference-mode gate independently from the stricter bilateral accounting gate.
Any failure returns only the relevant path to hold; it does not relax the target.
stop_conditions: No stable public machine-readable endpoint is identified.
S121 is not separately observable where required.
Any required F2-F8 instrument is absent from both stocks and financial transactions.
Only aggregated sectors are exposed where exact RMD mapping is impossible.
Only internally documented but non-public who-to-whom topology is confirmed.
Provider access failure remains indeterminate; it is not converted to absence.
